search_stickers: search the built-in sticker catalogue by keyword and return top N fuzzy matches
get_sticker_by_name: look up a sticker by its Chinese name with exact, substring, or description matching
get_sticker_by_id: find a sticker by its numeric sticker_id in the built-in catalogue
get_random_sticker: return a random sticker from the catalogue, optionally filtered by a category keyword
build_sticker_msg_body: build a TIMFaceElem message body list from a sticker dict for Yuanbao messaging
